page_title: MCI 5-1 BUR | Manchester City v Burnley 27/09/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.

90+3' 5 - 1 Erling Haaland (Manchester City) finishes his beautiful individual effort with a superb strike from inside the box. Martin Dubravka is just a bystander as the ball flies into bottom right corner. The score is 5:1.
90+2' Burnley are happy showing off their ball keeping skills and that is only interrupted when the defender steps in.
90' We will have 3 min. of added time.
90' 4 - 1 Erling Haaland (Manchester City) connects with a pass inside the box and slams home into the bottom right corner. The goalkeeper was helpless.
90' Manchester City seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
88' Scott Parker decides to make a substitution. Jaidon Anthony will be replaced by Bashir Humphreys (Burnley).
88' Substitution. Quilindschy Hartman will be replaced by Hannibal Mejbri (Burnley).
87' Phil Foden (Manchester City) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.

87' Martin Dubravka stretches to his left and makes a brilliant save! Erling Haaland (Manchester City) met a rebound outside the box and attempted to beat the keeper inside the right post. Good work from Manchester City as they win a corner.
87' Wonderful movement by Burnley. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
83' Pep Guardiola has decided to substitute Nico O'Reilly and he is replaced by Rico Lewis (Manchester City).
83' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Tijjani Reijnders as he is replaced by Bernardo Silva (Manchester City).
83' Phil Foden (Manchester City) is shown a deserved yellow card for saying too much to the referee.
83' Phil Foden (Manchester City) commits a foul after making a slide tackle on his opponent.

82' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Manchester City are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
80' Scott Parker has decided to make a change. Lesley Ugochukwu (Burnley) replaces Lyle Foster.
79' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Josh Cullen leaves the pitch and Armando Broja (Burnley) comes on.
79' Quilindschy Hartman (Burnley) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
76' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) zig-zags his way into the box and drills a low shot towards the left post, but the goalkeeper pulls off a superb stop.

74' Tijjani Reijnders (Manchester City) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and drills a nice strike from a promising distance towards the middle of the goal. Martin Dubravka has a clear sight of it and makes a comfortable save.
72' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending.
70' Substitution. Josko Gvardiol walks off the pitch and Nathan Ake (Manchester City) comes on as a substitute.
70' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) powers a header just wide of the right post following a cross into the middle of the box. The ball goes out of play and Burnley will have a goal kick.
69' Manchester City are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
65' Here is an example of luck not being on your side. Maxime Esteve (Burnley) puts the ball into the back of the net but, unfortunately for him, it's into his own goal!
63' Manchester City take a short corner kick.
63' Jaidon Anthony (Burnley) sees a yellow card. He should be more careful because one more challenge like that could result in a red card.
63' Here is a change. Savinho is going off and Pep Guardiola gives the last tactical orders to Oscar Bobb (Manchester City).
62' Loum Tchaouna will be replaced by Jacob Bruun Larsen (Burnley).
61' 2 - 1 Goal! Matheus Nunes (Manchester City) finds himself some space inside the box to get on the end of a pass from Erling Haaland, then sends the ball into the top right corner. 2:1.
59' Manchester City quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
59' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball goes out for a corner. Manchester City can continue in their attacking effort.
58' Savinho (Manchester City) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player. The linesman signals a throw-in for Manchester City.
56' Quilindschy Hartman (Burnley) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom left corner, but Gianluigi Donnarumma has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
55' Phil Foden (Manchester City) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
55' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger. It will be a corner kick for Manchester City.
53' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) gets himself onto the end of the corner, but his header is blocked.
53' Phil Foden (Manchester City) prepares to take a corner kick.

53' Nico O'Reilly (Manchester City) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Manchester City.
52' Kyle Walker (Burnley) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out. The ball is out of play. Burnley will have a throw-in.
50' Phil Foden (Manchester City) whips in a cross from the corner, but Martin Dubravka is well positioned and punches the ball away.
49' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) latches onto a cross inside the box and aims a shot towards the roof of the net, but Martin Dubravka reacts superbly to deny him.

49' Manchester City are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
47' Jaidon Anthony (Burnley) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
47' Lyle Foster (Burnley) bursts past a couple of players and shoots from the edge of the box, but his shot is blocked. Burnley have been awarded a corner kick.
47' Josko Gvardiol (Manchester City) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
46' Robert Jones blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+4' The match has reached half-time.
45+3' Savinho (Manchester City) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
45+1' Phil Foden (Manchester City) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.

45' Lyle Foster (Burnley) beats the defender to the lofted pass inside the box, but can't control his shot and it flashes well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Manchester City.
44' Burnley are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
43' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
40' The Manchester City players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.

38' 1 - 1 Goal! Quilindschy Hartman manages to prod the ball to Jaidon Anthony (Burnley) after a melee inside the box, and he needs no second invitation to slot the ball into the right side of the goal. 1:1.
38' Josh Laurent (Burnley) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Manchester City.
37' Burnley keep possession of the ball by producing one-two passes, but an opponent steps in and wins the ball. The ball has crossed the sideline. Burnley are taking a throw-in.
35' Manchester City are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
33' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. It's a throw-in for Manchester City.
30' Kyle Walker (Burnley) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Robert Jones ignores the protests.

28' Phil Foden (Manchester City) attempts to find one of his teammates with a ball from a free kick outside the box. The goalkeeper climbs high above all the players in the box to intercept the cross and snuff out the opportunity.
27' Quilindschy Hartman (Burnley) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Robert Jones had an easy-decision to make.
26' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Phil Foden (Manchester City), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
25' The corner from Phil Foden (Manchester City) is hurriedly cleared.

25' What an amazing save by Martin Dubravka! Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) swirls around the defenders and attempts to beat the keeper with a close-range shot towards the left side of the target, but fails.
23' A nice individual effort by Kyle Walker (Burnley) comes to nothing as his shot is blocked on the edge of the box by a defender.
23' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot. The ball goes out of play and Burnley will have a goal kick.

21' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Tijjani Reijnders (Manchester City). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate.

20' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Manchester City are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
17' Tijjani Reijnders (Manchester City) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
17' Lyle Foster (Burnley) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
15' Wonderful movement by Manchester City. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
12' It's an own goal! Maxime Esteve (Burnley) puts the ball into his own net.
11' The resulting corner from Phil Foden (Manchester City) comes to nothing.
11' Nico O'Reilly (Manchester City) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders. Manchester City win a corner.
11' The ball is cleared after Jaidon Anthony (Burnley) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
10' The ball is behind the touchline and Manchester City will take a throw-in. Kyle Walker (Burnley) is unable to feed a through ball into the path of his teammates.
7' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
5' Manchester City seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
4' Matheus Nunes (Manchester City) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
2' Nico (Manchester City) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.

2' Phil Foden (Manchester City) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Manchester City will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

2' Manchester City slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Burnley will have the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Robert Jones.
